   - The vertical barrier at x = 44 spans from y = 28 to y = 30, which will block any path that tries to go through this x-coordinate in that y-range.
   - The vertical barrier at x = 26 spans from y = 18 to y = 28, which will also block paths in that range.

2. Move right to x = 26 (still at y = 28).
3. Move down to y = 17 (to reach the goal).
